primary_model.description: unpaired robust limma; supplied normalized values; T minus U
primary_model.rationale: The worksheet labels three U/T replicates but does not document paired biological subjects. The unpaired model is therefore primary.

sensitivity_model.description: paired robust limma with replicate label as blocking term; sensitivity only

limitations: The workbook provides normalized values and headers, but no subject-level pairing metadata.
Differences are reported on the supplied normalized scale; they are not called fold changes.
The calculation is a secondary analysis of Table S11 and does not recreate the publication's full preprocessing pipeline.
